description: This file defines the MockServerLogger class responsible for logging within the MockServer project, including configuration, log event handling, and integration with external logging frameworks.

classes.name: MockServerLogger
classes.description: Main class for logging operations, configuration, and log event management within the MockServer framework.

methods.name: configureLogger
methods.description: Sets up logging configuration, including system properties and external logging frameworks.

methods.name: setHttpStateHandler
methods.description: Sets the HttpState handler for logging.

methods.name: logEvent
methods.description: Logs a LogEntry if conditions are met, either via HttpState or directly to system out.

methods.name: writeToSystemOut
methods.description: Outputs log entries to the configured logger based on log level and configuration.

methods.name: portInformation
methods.description: Returns port info string if available in LogEntry.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a log level is enabled based on current configuration.
